title: Renewal radar
summary: Paste your upcoming renewals and get each account risk-scored, with a pre-call brief for any customer call this week, emailed to you.
trigger: Manual run (pasted list or CSV of renewals); schedule it weekly
setup: Import the template and connect Google Calendar and Gmail.
Run it with your renewals pasted as CSV with a header row: account, domain, renewal_date, arr, notes. Only account and renewal_date are required; add domain so customer calls can be matched.
The radar is emailed to your connected Gmail address. Set `recipients` to send it to the team instead.
To get it every Monday, add a weekly schedule and save your renewal list as the default input.
Edit the `renewal-risk-analyst` agent to match how your team scores risk.
notes: Renewals come from the list you paste, not from a CRM or billing system. Keep the list current, or swap the first step for your CRM integration.
Risk is scored from your notes, the renewal date, ARR and whether a call is booked. It does not read product usage or support tickets.
Customer calls are matched by attendee email domain in the next 7 days. Accounts without a domain never match a call.
